name: Gamer Angel
source:
We follow the chaotic tale of Oscar Wymings, an angel who got kicked out of Heaven and into the fiery pits of Hell after neglecting his tasks in favour of video games one too many times.

Early in his escapades, he encounters Sir Simon Grassfellow, an upper class demon with a seemingly friendly demeanor, offering hospitality to Oscar in exchange for trivial house chores .

But this routine will be far from mundane as Oscar meets and interacts with all the residents of the Grassfellow manor, including a face all too familiar to us...

[from [url=https://drcllemlon.itch.io/gamer-angel-demo]itch.io[/url]]
